title: Great time !
text: I had an amazing time with Wendy, she is a great teacher. I left feeling relaxed and proud of my cup ! Thank you
author: H3878IEaureliel

title: Ceramics and fun
text: It was a beautiful morning thanks to Taller Gingell. I went with my family and we had a great time, learning about clay, talking with the rest of the workshop participants, and laughing a lot. Without a doubt, I will return to continue learning about the world of ceramics and have a good time.
author: 382rosamariap

title: Fantastic.
text:
I loved it! Wendy and Eric were very welcoming. There were only 3 of us, so it was almost a private workshop. Wendy explained everything perfectly to me, making me feel super comfortable.
I recommend it, I left wanting to return!
author: nataliarX1918ET

title: One of the best ceramics experiences so far.
text: One of the best ceramics experiences I’ve had so far. Wendy and Eric are absolute sweethearts and incredibly funny. Definitely a must try if you’re in Barcelona
author: sir291

title: Absolute recommendation
text: It was a really, really great workshop! Even my brother, who was skeptical, was enthusiastic and we are already looking forward to our works! Thank you very much, Wendy and Eric, for this great evening! It was an absolute highlight of our Barcelona vacation!
author: lenasophief2026

title: A super experience for a very special day with many details that are a plus! Highly recommended!
text:
To
As my first pottery workshop, I really enjoyed that they teach you the entire process. Wendy and Eric are very friendly. Wendy guides you and helps you at all times. And from this experience, you also take home a very nice memory, both the photos they take and the piece itself! Very cool!
author: D3344LIpatriciat

title: Great experience
text:
Great experience.
Excellent service from the moment we arrived. 
A very pleasant and recommended workshop where we were able to start in the world of clay. It has been a pleasure to do this craft in the company of family, guided very well by Wendy and Eric.
Thank you very much, Wendy and Eric.
author: Japll99

title: An experience to enjoy and let creativity fly:)
text:
It’s the second time I’ve done a workshop with Eric and Wendy and I’ll repeat again for sure, they’re amazing!
They organize everything very lovingly and teach all the techniques super well:)
They have a thousand details, such as going to advise you while you are doing your piece with things that they think may fit you, even offer you water or infusion, all are details that make you feel at home.
author: pauuu_pr

title: A Wonderful and Creative Pottery Experience
text:
For me, this was an incredible and heartwarming experience. Wendy and Eric are such amazing people. They carefully walk you through the different types of glazes and the techniques for creating your own piece. In our case, we made a mug.

There were a total of 6 people in the class, which made the atmosphere feel very friendly, personal, and welcoming. The class lasted for 2 and a half hours, but the time flew by so quickly because it was so engaging and enjoyable.

author: andrijad975

title: Clay, cups, learning and fun.
text:
Family experience in very good surroundings, with close professionals, fun and experts in ceramics.
It was our first time in a ceramic workshop and we left with very good taste in our mouths, highly recommended. Eric and Wendy teach and help as if you've known each other all your lives.
